metadata.description: Meta-skill that compresses other skills' instructions to cut token cost on repeat invocations, while preserving frontmatter and behavior-relevant content verbatim.

plugins.name: ozempskills
plugins.description: Routes skill invocations through a token-compressing cache: resolves a target skill's real source file, compresses its instructional body (frontmatter and all decision-relevant content preserved verbatim), and caches the result so repeat invocations of that skill cost fewer tokens.
